Waterfront (stored not waterfront) - contrary operator claim, re-audit lead (not changed): Campspot's description says 'Situated directly on the scenic banks of the Dolores River' and tags the park feature 'Waterfront'; the operator's page has a 'Riverside Deck' and 'River Access'. Worth a riverfront/riverview look against the site map.
